name: Tracearr SSE
description: Streams playback start, progress, pause, stop, session connect and disconnect, library item added, removed, and downloaded, converted downloads, scheduled task lifecycle, and server CPU/RAM stat events as Server-Sent Events, plus a hello event carrying the plugin version. Built for Tracearr. Works with any SSE client.
overview: Real-time playback, session, library, download, task, and server stat events over Server-Sent Events.

versions.changelog:
- `library.item.downloaded` event on Jellyfin and Emby when a user downloads an item, from the server's activity log. Payload carries `userId`, `itemId` (absent on Emby, whose entry has none), `itemName` (the activity entry's name), and `app` and `device` parsed from the entry's overview.
- On Emby, the activity entry names the user by numeric internal id, so `library.item.downloaded` looks the user up and sends the same 32-character GUID that playback events carry. `userId` is omitted when no user matches.
- `download.transcoded` event on Jellyfin for clients that download at reduced quality through the stream endpoint, which logs no activity. A device session that transcodes without reporting playback for 20 seconds emits `phase: "started"`, and `phase: "ended"` when the transcode goes away. Payload carries `userId`, `deviceId`, `itemId`, `bitrate`, `width`, `height`, `videoCodec`, `audioCodec`, `container`, `bytesTranscoded`, and `completionPercentage`. `itemId` and `bytesTranscoded` are read from Jellyfin's internal transcoding job list and are omitted if that read fails.
- The events endpoint now requires an administrator or an API key on both Jellyfin and Emby.

- Jellyfin builds now target .NET 10 against the Jellyfin 12.0 plugin ABI. Jellyfin 12 moved the server to .NET 10 and changed several plugin interfaces, so a 10.11 build does not load on it. Catalog entries carry `targetAbi` 12.0.0.0, which hides them from 10.11 servers; 0.4.1 stays the last release for 10.11.
- Emby is unaffected. `Emby.Plugin.Sse` is still netstandard2.0 and still targets Emby 4.9+.

- Emby dashboard thumbnail is the 16:9 catalog tile instead of the square Tracearr logo.
- Catalog art replaced: a 1920x1080 tile shared by the Jellyfin catalog and the Emby thumb, and an Emby terminal preview showing the wire format. The old images were Tracearr app placeholders.
- Both catalog manifests describe the full event set and carry per-version release notes; new releases pull them from this changelog.
Adds server.stats CPU/RAM samples every 6 seconds while a client is connected, and task.started, task.progress, and task.completed events from the scheduled task manager.
Adds library.item.added and library.item.removed events carrying itemId, itemType, and parentId.
Adds the hello event on connect, disconnects subscribers whose buffer fills so they reconnect and resync, raises the per-subscriber buffer to 512, and makes release builds report their real version.
First release: playing, progress, paused, stopped, session.start, and session.end events plus a ping keepalive every 30 seconds.
